steps.title: Analyze Root Cause of Product Entry Failure
steps.description: Identified that new Product instances with default ID 0 were misclassified as Edit mode instead of Add mode.

steps.title: Fix Add vs Edit Mode Detection in Product Form
steps.description: Updated mode checking so that only products with an ID greater than zero trigger Edit mode.

steps.title: Fix Product ID Handling for New Product Instances
steps.description: Ensure SQLite auto-assigns primary key IDs upon insert rather than executing update queries on ID 0.

steps.title: Add Code & Barcode Validation and Auto-Generation
steps.description: Auto-generate product codes when left empty and validate barcode uniqueness prior to database insertion.

steps.title: Enhance Database Helper Exception Handling
steps.description: Wrap database CRUD operations in try-catch blocks and log explicit errors to Logcat for diagnostics.

steps.title: Improve UI Feedback for Product Form Dialog
steps.description: Provide distinct error messages for duplicate barcodes, invalid input formats, or insertion failures.

steps.title: Verify Stock Movement Integration
steps.description: Confirm initial stock transactions are recorded properly upon adding a product with initial stock.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Ensure anonymous inner classes are used throughout all adapters and listeners without syntax errors.

steps.title: Validate Inventory Dashboard Metrics
steps.description: Verify product counts, low stock items, and stock movements recalculate after product creation.

steps.title: Building Box Stock Manager
steps.description: Compile updated source files and assemble the final release APK.
